name: First Digital Acquisition Corp Ltd.
summary: CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III, Ltd does not have significant operations. It focuses on effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was formerly known as CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III, Ltd and changed its name to First Digital Acquisition Corp Ltd. in November 2026. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
